P-001.title: User plan: Addition Neural Network Plan
P-001.notes: Defines B-001 scope: two integer inputs, range 0..100, target sum, small feed-forward neural network, dataset/training/evaluation/inference/save requirements.

P-002.title: PyTorch Datasets & DataLoaders tutorial
P-002.notes: Supports representing generated examples as samples with labels/targets and wrapping them in DataLoader for batching and optional shuffling.
relevant_sections: Preparing your data for training with DataLoaders

P-003.title: PyTorch Build the Neural Network tutorial
P-003.notes: Supports using nn.Module or nn.Sequential with Linear and ReLU layers for a feed-forward model that maps input tensors to outputs.

P-004.title: PyTorch Linear API reference
P-004.notes: Defines affine layer behavior and input/output shape contract needed for two inputs and one predicted scalar output.

P-005.title: PyTorch MSELoss API reference
P-005.notes: Supports treating addition as a scalar regression problem with mean squared prediction error.

P-006.title: PyTorch Saving and Loading Models tutorial
P-006.notes: Supports saving trained model weights as a reusable artifact and restoring them for inference.

P-007.title: User plan: Addition Neural Network Plan
P-007.notes: Defines B-002 implementation deliverables: dataset generation, model definition, training loop, evaluation metrics, save/load, inference entry point, and tests.

P-008.title: PyTorch Datasets & DataLoaders tutorial
P-008.notes: Supports concrete dataset generation/storage contracts and DataLoader batching for training and evaluation.
relevant_sections: Preparing your data for training with DataLoaders

P-009.title: PyTorch Build the Neural Network tutorial
P-009.notes: Supports implementing a model class with `forward`, `nn.Linear`, `nn.ReLU`, and `nn.Sequential` components.

P-010.title: PyTorch Optimizing Model Parameters tutorial
P-010.notes: Supports training-loop responsibilities: compute prediction/loss, backpropagate, optimizer step, zero gradients, and separate evaluation loop.

P-011.title: PyTorch MSELoss API reference
P-011.notes: Supports evaluation metrics based on prediction error for scalar regression.

P-012.title: PyTorch Saving and Loading Models tutorial
P-012.notes: Supports save/load implementation and inference restoration behavior.

P-013.title: PyTorch Reproducibility note
P-013.notes: Supports setting deterministic seeds for repeatable tests and development runs, without promising cross-platform bit-for-bit reproducibility.

P-014.title: pytest invocation documentation
P-014.notes: Supports providing tests that can be run from the command line for dataset, model, training, save/load, and inference behavior.

P-015.title: User plan: Addition Neural Network Plan
P-015.notes: Defines B-003 non-goals and required commands for tests, training, evaluation, and sample inference.

P-016.title: PyTorch Optimizing Model Parameters tutorial
P-016.notes: Supports separating train and evaluation flows for command-level verification.

P-017.title: PyTorch Saving and Loading Models tutorial
P-017.notes: Supports verification that trained artifacts can be loaded for inference commands.

P-018.title: PyTorch no_grad API reference
P-018.notes: Supports inference/evaluation commands running without gradient calculation.

P-019.title: pytest invocation documentation
P-019.notes: Supports providing a test command for project verification.

P-020.title: Python argparse documentation
P-020.notes: Supports command-line entry points for train, evaluate, and infer scripts without a web UI.

P-021.title: PyTorch Reproducibility note
P-021.notes: Supports development/test stability for verification runs without optimizing for production-scale determinism or performance.
